_note: How hunters, bots and remote players use the stairs, ladders and drops of the continuous levels (hunters/flight_edges.rs). ladder_speed_scale multiplies the climb speed of a ladder (vertical.rs LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED, m/s). drop_allowed lets a hunter jump down a drop (waterfall or hole); one way, off by default. drop_fall_speed is the speed of that fall in m/s. edge_cost_scale (at least 1) multiplies the path cost of a flight, a ladder or a drop. reference_speed is the hunter walk speed in m/s that turns a ladder climb time into a path cost. hear_adjacent_scale is the factor on a sound's radius when it is one storey away (0 = not heard). see_adjacent lets a hunter see a target one storey away through an open well. capture_height is the largest height difference in metres at which a hunter captures. edge_enter_radius is how close in metres a hunter must be to the entrance of an edge to start walking it. edge_fit_radius is the body radius in metres of the footprint test while walking an edge (the runner's radius, because the routes of the flights are validated for it; the wider hunter body would stall at the tight turn of a mid landing). edge_stuck_seconds is how long a hunter or bot may fail to progress on an edge before it replans. resident_hunter_cap is how many hunters a resident floor beside the active one simulates.
